name: Kitchen-hung meat
summary: Thịt treo gác bếp is meat hung over the kitchen fire: local black pork on the western road, and beef and black pork on the northern road.
origin: The western road and the northern road.
howToEat: Look for it in the villages of both routes.
seoTitle: Kitchen-hung pork and beef in Cao Bang
